Asset.title: Asset
Asset.description: A physical or capital corporate asset tracked in inventory with valuation, assignment, lifecycle status, and photo.

assetId.description: Unique identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated organization owner.

serialNumber.description: Manufacturer serial number, SKU, or model identifier.

currentValuation.description: Current book or market valuation in USD.

warrantyExpiry.description: ISO calendar date of warranty expiration (YYYY-MM-DD) or empty string if none.

status.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the asset.

department.description: Corporate department responsible for the asset.

location.description: Physical site, floor, room, or bay where the asset resides.

assignedTo.description: Employee or custodian assigned to the asset, or empty string if unassigned.

notes.description: Condition notes, service instructions, or procurement details.

photoUrl.description: Firebase Storage HTTPS URL, local asset URL, or compressed offline data URI.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the asset was first registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the asset was last updated.

AssetEvent.title: AssetEvent
AssetEvent.description: Immutable audit trail entry recording registration or modifications to a parent Asset.

eventId.description: Unique identifier matching the event document ID.

assetId.description: Identifier of the parent Asset document.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner matching parent Asset ownerId.

summary.description: Concise human-readable description of the change.

actorEmail.description: Verified email address of the authenticated user who performed the action.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the audit event occurred.

/assets/{assetId}.description: Primary corporate inventory collection storing tracked assets scoped to their authenticated owner.

/assets/{assetId}/events/{eventId}.description: Append-only subcollection recording timestamped lifecycle and valuation audit events for each asset.
